A Callum Keown market report carried by MSN says Anthropic traded at $81.12, down 7.4%, early Tuesday and below its $83 IPO price. It compares the short period since flotation with historical examples including Meta, Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX, while describing weakness across AI-linked shares.

The figures are an intraday snapshot, not a closing price or a live quote. Historical winners do not establish the probability of a similar recovery, especially with different starting valuations. This market report does not settle Anthropic's technical prospects or the causes of the broader selloff and is not an investment recommendation.
highlights: Report gives an early-Tuesday price of $81.12
Historical comparisons have different valuations and conditions
Intraday prices can change before the close
Market reaction is distinct from technical capability
